theorems.name: Submission.ind_pi_ss_cycle_slice_boundary
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U m), IsOpen U → T.boundary = 0 → IsSlice T f t S → ∃ A : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsRestriction T {x | x ∈ U ∧ f x < t} A ∧ A.boundary = S
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
